project.name: auto-meds
project.description: Smart E-Pharma, Automated Refill Subscriptions & Clinical Triage Platform with OCR prescription verification, 2-tier inventory soft-locking, and Twilio WhatsApp interactive refills.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Core patient, pharmacist, and administrator identity records.

nodes.name: medicines
nodes.summary: Pharmaceutical catalog including stock_quantity and reserved_quantity for 2-tier inventory.

nodes.name: medicine_batches
nodes.summary: Batch numbers, manufacturer details, and expiry date tracking.

nodes.name: prescriptions
nodes.summary: Uploaded prescriptions, Tesseract OCR confidence scores, and pharmacist triage state.

nodes.name: orders
nodes.summary: Patient purchase orders with tracking, dispensing slips, and delivery details.

nodes.name: order_items
nodes.summary: Line items associated with prescription and OTC orders.

nodes.name: caregiver_access
nodes.summary: Caregiver consent mappings, WhatsApp opt-in, and authorization scopes.

nodes.name: audit_logs
nodes.summary: HIPAA/CDSCO tamper-evident clinical action and dispensing logs.

nodes.name: cart
nodes.summary: Active patient shopping cart sessions with timestamp tracking.

nodes.name: cart_items
nodes.summary: Active medicine items and quantities in cart.

nodes.name: payments
nodes.summary: Payment transactions, mock gateways, and receipt metadata.

nodes.name: shedlock
nodes.summary: Distributed lock coordinator table preventing concurrent refill cron execution.

nodes.name: POST /api/auth/login
nodes.summary: Authenticates patients/pharmacists and issues JWT Bearer token.

nodes.name: POST /api/auth/register
nodes.summary: Registers new patients or caregivers in the system.

nodes.name: GET /api/medicines
nodes.summary: Queries the medicine catalog (cached in Caffeine).

nodes.name: POST /api/prescriptions/upload
nodes.summary: Handles multipart Rx image upload and initiates async OCR parsing.

nodes.name: PUT /api/prescriptions/{id}/triage
nodes.summary: Allows licensed pharmacists to approve or reject prescription submissions.

nodes.name: POST /api/subscriptions
nodes.summary: Establishes automated recurring refill schedules for chronic illness care.

nodes.name: POST /api/caregiver/whatsapp-command
nodes.summary: Inbound Twilio webhook processing "YES" confirmation messages.

nodes.name: POST /api/orders/checkout
nodes.summary: Finalizes order placement, releases soft-locks into physical deduction, and creates QR slip.

nodes.name: GET /api/realtime/sse
nodes.summary: Server-Sent Events stream delivering live pharmacy triage updates and order tracking.

layers.name: Ingress & Reverse Proxy Tier
layers.description: Edge gateways, NGINX reverse proxy, SSL termination, and Docker compose orchestration.

layers.name: Frontend Client Tier (Angular 16)
layers.description: Angular SPA UI components for Patients, Caregivers, and Pharmacist Admin consoles.

layers.name: Frontend Reactive Services & State
layers.description: Angular HTTP services, JWT interceptors, Auth guards, and SSE real-time client bus.

layers.name: Security & Filter Chain Tier
layers.description: Spring Security filter chain, Correlation ID propagation, Token-bucket rate limiting, and JWT authentication.

layers.name: REST API & Controller Tier
layers.description: Spring Boot REST Controllers, Request DTOs, and REST Endpoints serving clinical transactions.

layers.name: Domain Business Logic & Clinical Engines
layers.description: Core application services, 2-tier inventory soft-locking engine, drug interaction checkers, and Twilio WhatsApp handlers.

layers.name: Schedulers & Asynchronous Workers
layers.description: Distributed ShedLock refill cron schedulers, batch expiration checks, and async OCR workers.

layers.name: Persistence & Relational Data Tier (PostgreSQL 16)

layers.name: DevOps, CI/CD & Architectural Documentation

tour.title: 1. Ingress & Edge Proxying
tour.description: Requests arrive at NGINX Alpine, which serves cached static assets, terminates compression, and reverse-proxies /api traffic to Spring Boot Undertow on port 8080.

tour.title: 2. Security Interceptor & JWT Filter Chain
tour.description: Every request passes through CorrelationIdFilter (MDC tracking), Token-Bucket Rate Limiter, and JwtAuthenticationFilter before reaching controllers.

tour.title: 3. Prescription Upload & OCR Triage Flow
tour.description: Prescription images are received via REST endpoint, analyzed asynchronously using OCR, and routed to licensed pharmacists for clinical verification.

tour.title: 4. 2-Tier Inventory Engine & 5-Day Soft-Locking
tour.description: Prevents stock hoarding and race conditions by maintaining physical stock_quantity alongside a temporary 5-day reserved_quantity soft lock.

tour.title: 5. ShedLock 5-Day Refill & Twilio Interactive Flow
tour.description: Distributed ShedLock cron scheduler sweeps active subscriptions 5 days prior to exhaustion and dispatches Twilio SMS/WhatsApp messages asking patients to "Reply YES".

tour.title: 6. Frontend Reactive State & Real-Time SSE Bus
tour.description: Angular 16 client connects to Server-Sent Events bus for real-time inventory level sync and prescription triage alerts without page refreshes.
